notes.text: Chat answers better: it reads misspellings, follows a conversation, compares products, offers "Did you mean" and recommends products, with its own words and prices in each market
Chat handles basic support: order status and booking details by email, complaints with a ticket number, and a hand-over to a person
Complaints show in Form submissions with a status: new, replied or resolved
Visitors outside your markets can see a market’s prices in their own currency where your payment connection can charge it, else in US dollars
A market charged in US dollars uses a real exchange rate, never one for one
Checkout lets buyers change quantities and remove lines
A bookable session shows times in the visitor’s market’s time zone, with a booking note per market
Email settings set up in four steps, and a plugin’s page reads in plain words and warns before switching off
Pages can carry a short video over the API
Pages built ahead of time use your own settings, and an agent’s sign-in link opens on your site’s own address
A MongoDB site whose database user has rights to some collections only (as on Atlas) builds and starts: collections are looked up one name at a time
A database that refuses one index change no longer stops the others; the error is logged
An image's credit is kept with it, and the same image sent twice is kept once (mmp 1.72.11)
Admin_login_link: an agent's key makes a one-time sign-in link, read-only keys open a view-only session
Update_product also sets position, badges, related products and a bundle's contents
Agents can read and change a session's booking rules: get_booking_config and update_booking_config
Agents can list collections and put products in one or take them out
Agents can note an order, mark it fulfilled and record an offline payment
A submission's status: update_submission marks it new, read or done, and list_submissions filters by it
Agents can change the store's name, contact details, menus and SEO: update_settings_slice
A failed settings read answers "try again", not the switch's guess
A tool refuses an argument it doesn't declare, and initialize says which build it is
Create_market and update_market dry runs show the market as it would be saved, as on mmp 1.72.2
Photos and contact buttons per market, and images are always the site's own (mmp 1.72.10)
A market can have its own product picture and gallery, and update_product copies an image from a link
A market's own product words show on its pages: name, description, search result and button
One small MongoDB pool per instance, which a site's own code shares (mmp 1.72.9)
A product's words per market: update_product and get_product take market
A product with no price in a market is shown and sold there in naira, not refused
The header's market picker offers Nigeria (your own prices), and a Nigerian visitor sees it picked
A site can serve its own home page at /, with SITE_HOME_PATH
A site's own pages keep their words per market, editable in Content → Pages and the pages API
A MongoDB site's build loads the database code by its file path, so tsx running prepare.mts resolves it
The Preview as hint reads as a sentence, and the markets smoke tests find the editions' tabs
1.1.1, its first-state check on Where, for admin 1.60.0
Only a market's converted product price rounds up to the next 10; Everyone else keeps its rounding
Products has one "Preview as" menu, and the preview bar has a market picker and Exit preview
A converted price rounds up to the next 10, shown and charged alike
A product can be hidden where your own prices apply (Nigeria)
Page dry runs show the page before and after, and the contract test has a page and a market to read
The Markets editor saves again with Everyone else in the list
Preview a market (drafts too) from Markets and Products, and the Markets page and editions read like mmp 1.71.4
The build's plugin step opens the database the app opens, mmp_admin on a switched mmp site and never its CRM
With no admin database named, a switched mmp site opens mmp_admin, not an empty one
A bookable session with no plans sells at its edition's price, and market prices answer as on mmp 1.70.10
Agents can manage markets and load each market's prices over the API and MCP, as on mmp 1.70.8
A bookable session is sold in each market at its own plan prices, and a product can be hidden in a market
Mmp 1.70.6 and 1.70.7 in the admin: an assistant sees the API's errors, dry runs check the key and the handle and show before and after, and Markets' currency fixes
A site's own page words are edited in Content → Pages, and agents can read and change every page
No MongoDB index is another's twin or prefix, so an mmp database gains nothing redundant
A MongoDB site's build reads its downloaded plugins and records the build
The absence matrix fails a hung step in 20 minutes, and unit runs share one in-memory MongoDB
MongoDB opens MMP_ADMIN_DB before MONGODB_DB, and never writes into a CRM's database
An index that conflicts is tried again after the backfills, so an mmp database's first boot logs nothing
Pg-to-mongo moves a site's Postgres into MongoDB, with a dry run, a guard, resume and verify
What's live shows on a MongoDB site too
Deleting a revoked key works on MongoDB too
Moving a booking over its own old time checks the other bookings on MongoDB too
The Plugins page shows the owner's switches on MongoDB
Core's own tables get their MongoDB indexes, under mmp's names
The signing key, opt-outs, admin preferences and Bachs's fee bearer on MongoDB
Uploaded images, the analytics beacon and Resend's reports on MongoDB as well
A booking's refundable order on MongoDB gives its id as text, as Postgres does
The delivery log's Resend and the developer tools switch on MongoDB
The submissions export runs on MongoDB, read in batches
What switching a feature off affects reads MongoDB too
Get plugin and Remove store installs on MongoDB as well
Local currency joins Markets on MongoDB too, and Markets runs on MongoDB
Submissions are stored, listed and deleted on MongoDB as well
Core's booking reads and writes run on MongoDB as well
A booking's reschedule, cancel and refund, and the Bookings list, on MongoDB too
Reviews, Promo codes, Bookings, Automations and Conversions say they run on Neon, Postgres and MongoDB
Mongo reads never migrate, and Mongo indexes keep their default names
Nine plugins that read and write MongoDB take a minor version for admin 1.60.0
Automations' engine, builder, seeding, tracking and results read and write MongoDB too
Reviews, Promo codes, Bookings, Newsletter, Markets, Shipping, Forms, Conversions and Automations' order page read and write MongoDB too
Imported pages, Membership, Paid access and Blog say they run on Neon, Postgres and MongoDB
Posts can be kept on a MongoDB site
Grants, access codes and receipt links work on a MongoDB site
Membership runs on a site whose data is in MongoDB
Imported pages run on a site whose data is in MongoDB
Core's reads and writes on Store's tables run on MongoDB as well
What each automation sent and earned, on MongoDB as on Postgres
Home's visits, the dashboard's breakdowns, Live View and the Orders list on MongoDB
MongoDB indexes for the checkout sweep and each order's refunds, follow-ups and downloads
An order's page, the checkout sweep, Store's automation triggers, upsell sales and the thank-you links read and write MongoDB too
A plugin's one-time data step gets the site's database, SQL or MongoDB
Store 1.5.0 runs on Neon, Postgres and MongoDB
Abandoned checkouts, the reminder's checks, customers' spend and Store's indexes on MongoDB
On MongoDB the first boot gives every feature its first state, from what the site uses
Home's visits, Analytics' breakdowns, Live View and the Orders list read MongoDB too, and answer as on Postgres
Outgoing webhooks on MongoDB, queued and claimed on the database's clock
A plugin's data and its detectors name rows with a Where, so counting, export, delete and first states run on MongoDB too
Product files in the database on MongoDB, a piece stored and then counted
Analytics, Explore and Store's sales reports answer the same on MongoDB as on Postgres
API keys and their audit log on MongoDB, a roll in one transaction
Idempotency-Key on MongoDB, claimed on the database's clock, kept by a TTL index
Store's orders API, customers, refunds, order actions, fulfilment and exports run on MongoDB
Store's checkout, downloads and Home cards run on MongoDB as well
Job leases on MongoDB, timed by the database's own clock
Settings, secrets and the plugins rows on MongoDB, and a read there never migrates
Storefront 1.1.0 and Meta catalog feed 1.1.0 say they run on Neon, Postgres and MongoDB
AnalyticsEventDoc, an analytics event as a MongoDB document with every column
Payments says it runs on Neon, Postgres and MongoDB
Payments runs on MongoDB as well (payments 1.2.0)
A plugin says which databases it runs on, and a site never gets one that doesn't run on its own
MongoDB's indexes and backfills run under a lease, one instance at a time
Copying a site's Postgres data into MongoDB, in the shape the Mongo branches read
A Mongo read marks the page dynamic the way a no-store fetch does, and tests never reach a real Mongo
A Mongo read makes the page dynamic, and Mongo's one-off changes are backfills in _migrations
Exact money and one filter shape on both backends, collations, and Mongo for unit tests
The admin's data on Neon, any Postgres or MongoDB, chosen by the site's environment
AI agents: name an agent, add it, and give any AI assistant or MCP client its key, address, header and config; revoke or delete it from the same page
Every change an AI agent makes is a dry run first, and agent requests are rate-limited per key
A new API key starts on Secret, the kind a server or an AI agent needs
The payment keys page is now Connected services, and it and API keys point to each other
Payments 1.1.1 and Store 1.4.1 carry the new page name in their help
Meta catalog feed: a product feed for WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram shops, as a plugin
A site can add its own admin link to a page of its own, such as a CRM
Store 1.4.0 and Chat 1.1.0 share what a site’s own code needs from them
Plugins can offer a newer version for newer admins while older sites keep the version they can run
New versions of 16 plugins, including Store 1.3.0, Payments 1.1.0 and Markets 1.3.0
The admin builds and passes its checks with any plugin left out
The Store, Payments and the Storefront are plugins you can get from Plugins, like the others
Sales reports, Home’s sales figures and the shop’s policy texts come from the Store plugin
Older Conversions, Bookings and Forms plugins keep their webhook events, secrets and purchase reports
Settings has one link for Updates & developers and one for Brand & marketing; their screens are tabs
Abandoned checkouts is a tab of Orders
An order’s timeline shows its receipt and the shop’s order notice
A site without Conversions no longer sends purchases to ad platforms
Plugins page: the page numbers no longer touch Get more plugins
Every order has its own page: items, payment, customer, shipping address, where they came from, staff notes and a timeline
Test orders are clearly marked, so you can tell them from real sales
Your site’s settings are always used on its pages, even ones made while it was building
A plugin that fails to start is retried once a minute instead of on every visit
Local currency is now part of Markets: each market either shows local prices automatically or uses prices you set for that country
Everyone else is a market too, for visitors from countries you haven’t set up
Settings saved while the site is building now always reach your database
Plugins you get are checked against Pengroove’s signature before your site uses them
Bookings, Automations and other plugins work correctly when the plugins they rely on are removed
Plugins can be added to your site from the Plugins page, so your admin only carries what you use
Chat, Newsletter, Reviews, Promo codes, Membership, Paid access, Shipping, Cookie consent and Imported pages are now separate plugins
Switching a plugin off can no longer change another plugin’s settings
Checkout and newsletter automations wait until Automations is switched on
Connect your AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT) to your admin out of the box, with a key you create
Pages can be for signed-in members only
Email keys now live in Settings → Email
Switched-off Conversions and Automations now send nothing at all
Missing files are answered from the fast cache instead of the server
Your site's pages and imported pages are listed together under Pages, not as separate menu links
Updates shows your version, a Check for updates button, what's new and how to update
The Plugins page has search, filters, pages and a details page for every plugin, with its version and what's new
See plugins you don't have yet, and newer versions of the ones you do
Bring in a template you bought or a site you built elsewhere, with step-by-step help
Links to pages ending in .html work, add-to-cart buttons work without code, and plain HTML forms send their answers
/cart opens checkout
Checkout only accepts whole-number quantities
Draft and archived products can't be bought
Saving the Home page in one tab no longer undoes changes made in another

plugins.description: Write posts and publish them on your site at /blog

notes.text: Shipping: charge for delivery and collect the buyer's address at checkout
Products in colours and sizes, with swatches and a photo for each option
Choose which page is your home page
The Plugins page shows each plugin as a card
Forms on your own pages send their answers to Form submissions
Import members from a spreadsheet
Updates: see when a newer version is out and what it brings
Pages load faster and use less server time
Images are converted once, not every time they're shown
Imported pages are served from the fast cache again
Pages can show images from Unsplash

update.message: To update, open your site's repository on GitHub and press Sync fork, or contact us and we'll update it for you.
